358 likes, 7 comments - sasswcass on October 9, 2026: "₹8 lakh in credit card debt on a ₹60K salary. Where would you even start? 💸

The answer isn’t just cutting chai and cancelling Netflix. It’s reducing interest, controlling spending, and finding ways to increase your income.

Because when your debt is growing faster than your savings, you don’t have a budgeting problem. You have a debt emergency.

Save this for when you need a financial reset. 📌

#PersonalFinance #CreditCardDebt #MoneyManagement #FinancialLiteracy #DebtFreeJourney".
